# oss-pce-cd-bios

> Open-source PC Engine / TurboGrafx-CD Super System Card 3.0 BIOS replacement project. This is development-only firmware, not a commercially compatible BIOS or a distributable replacement release.

Project home (English): https://mao2009.github.io/oss-pce-cd-bios/
Project home (Japanese): https://mao2009.github.io/oss-pce-cd-bios/ja/
Source repository: https://github.com/mao2009/oss-pce-cd-bios

## Scope and verified progress (2026-10-20, main 963f3a36)

- Target: replace the software System Card BIOS, not the PC Engine CD hardware.
- 256 KiB development-only ROM with 81 candidate System Card API slots.
- Exactly one slot ($1E, EX_GETVER) has a callable original OSS development implementation; 80 other slots are nonreturning stubs.
- Pinned Geargrafx emulator-core cold/warm tests observed EX_GETVER returning to its caller with X=3, Y=0, and A preserved.
- Synthetic SCSI READ(6) sector-to-RAM and payload execution experiments are diagnostics, NOT callable CD_READ firmware or BIOS-mediated disc boot.
- No BIOS-mediated CD program boot has been verified as of 2026-10-20; 765 host passes at PR #174 is only a historical count, not a current total.
- Standalone EX_BINBCD, EX_BCDBIN, MA_MUL8S and MA_MUL8U routines (#328/#331) are not BIOS jump-table entries. #345 separates real-core from host tests.
- #360/#362 catalogue unsafe write paths and pre-side-effect probes; reference JSR remains BLOCKED.
- #371/#359 validate measurement/log and claim correspondence, not authenticated producer evidence or reference ABI compatibility.
- #374/#349 strengthen Pages privilege isolation and fail-closed artifact publishing checks within limited scope.
- The reference BIOS ABI remains UNVERIFIED and release_eligible is false.
- No verified commercial game boot, physical hardware compatibility, or independent emulator cross-check has been established. CD_RESET, CD_BASE and CD_READ callable firmware services remain unimplemented.

## Interpretation rules

Use source-linked, dated claims. Keep real-core emulator observations separate from verified reference-BIOS ABI and retail compatibility. Do not claim the project is ready for end users, that all candidate APIs are implemented, or that diagnostic successes prove actual game boot. Do not ingest or redistribute private proprietary BIOS ROMs, game media, or protected data from local reference experiments. Source files are MIT-licensed only to the extent covered by this project's license; imported third-party OSS remains under its own terms.

This optional text index supplements crawlable HTML. It is not a required AI-search protocol, not a robots.txt directive, and not a promise that any AI service will index or cite the site.
